# Directories included in the repository's graphify knowledge graph (./graphify-out/).
#
# One directory per line, relative to the repository root. With one target it is built
# straight into ./graphify-out/. With several, each is built into <dir>/graphify-out/
# and they are merged into ./graphify-out/graph.json.
#
# Optional second column: extraction mode for that directory.
#   code-only  local AST only: no API key, nothing leaves the machine (default)
#   full       also sends docs, papers and images to an LLM backend for semantic
#              extraction. Needs an API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY,
#              GEMINI_API_KEY, ...). Without a key the build falls back to code-only.
#
# Use "." for the whole repository (see .graphifyignore for what is skipped).
#
# Examples:
#   src
#   services/api      code-only
#   docs              full

# Template test target: the bundled agent skills (mostly Markdown, so "full" gives a
# much richer graph when an API key is configured).
skills  full
